HCM360 · Daily Dose #1
🤖  Just ask ARIA
Your HR data, on tap. Type a question, get a real answer.

ARIA is the natural-language assistant inside HCM360. Type a question in plain English and ARIA pulls the answer LIVE from your database — no spreadsheets, no waiting on someone to run a report.

Why it's cool
  • Wired to 32 live data sources: employees, attendance, leave, payroll, performance, eligibility, and more.
  • Every answer cites the source it queried — no hallucinations, no guesswork.
  • Conversational: ask follow-ups like “break that down by department” and ARIA remembers context.
  • Role-aware: ARIA only reads data your role is allowed to see.
How to use it
  1. Click 🤖 ARIA Chat in the Quick Actions bar (always pinned for Manager+).
  2. Try one of the quick-action buttons or type your own question.
  3. Use the 👍 / 👎 reaction to teach ARIA what worked.
Open ARIA →

HCM360 · Daily Dose #2
🎛  Make the Dashboard yours
Pin the metrics you actually care about. Hide the rest.

The Dashboard ships with sensible role defaults, but you can curate it down to the 4 or 40 KPIs that matter to YOU. Pin once, and HCM360 remembers across every login.

Why it's cool
  • 120+ KPIs in the library, grouped into Workforce, Talent, Compensation, Compliance, and Operations.
  • Tiles are click-through — every number opens a filtered drill-down list.
  • Trend arrows compare to the previous period, in colour.
  • Widgets (live panels like Today's Attendance Board) are pinnable too.
How to use it
  1. Click ⚙ Manage Dashboard at the top of the Key Metrics row.
  2. Browse the KPI Library by category, or search by keyword.
  3. Tap the pin icon on each tile you want, then drag to reorder.
  4. Click Save — done. It's yours from now on.
Customise my dashboard →

HCM360 · Daily Dose #3
📸  Smile, you're checked in
Face Check-In replaces the punch card. Walk up, look up, done.

Step up to a Face Check-In kiosk anywhere in the building and the camera does the rest. No biometric thumb. No log book. No signing other people in.

Why it's cool
  • Stamp lands in your DTR within 2 seconds.
  • Three sources of truth combined: face, biometric, manual. Each scan is tagged so HR can audit.
  • Auto-classifies on-time vs late vs absent; tolerance configurable.
  • If you forget to check in, file a Manual Adjustment from My Attendance — supervisor approves in one click.
How to use it
  1. Walk up to a kiosk and look at the camera. (You'll hear a chime.)
  2. Verify your name on the screen.
  3. Open My Attendance later to see your hours roll up.
See my attendance →

HCM360 · Daily Dose #4
💰  Payroll, end-to-end on one screen
Eight stages, one map, every government form generated for you.

Payroll has always been a pile of spreadsheets and dread. The Payroll Dashboard's 8-stage pipeline turns that into a single clickable map — Pay Period → Timekeeping → Loans → Run → Review → Government Reports → Release → Close.

Why it's cool
  • Auto-generates SSS R3, PhilHealth RF1, HDMF MCRF, BIR 1601-C — and BIR 2316 at year-end.
  • Loans (SSS, Pag-IBIG, company) amortise automatically across cutoffs.
  • Digital seal on every payslip. COA-friendly audit trail on every adjustment.
  • Click any stage card to jump straight to that step. No more bookmarks.
How to use it
  1. Open Payroll → Dashboard.
  2. Follow the numbered cards 1 → 8 in order.
  3. Use + New Run to start a cutoff; the system pre-fills from timekeeping.
Open Payroll →

HCM360 · Daily Dose #5
☂  Leave, without the paperwork
File a CS Form 6 in 30 seconds. From your phone. Approved in your inbox.

No more printing CS Form 6, finding the supervisor, walking it to HR. File from anywhere, watch the status update live, and your CS Form 6 generates itself once approved.

Why it's cool
  • Real-time balance check as you pick the leave type.
  • Half-day, multi-day, and partial-day VL all supported.
  • Approval workflow flows to your supervisor, then HR — visible on every screen.
  • Approved request auto-generates the CS Form 6 PDF with digital signatures.
How to use it
  1. Open My Leaves from the sidebar.
  2. Click + File Leave Request.
  3. Pick type, dates, attach a medical cert if Sick > 5 days, and submit.
  4. Watch the status update in My Inbox.
File leave →

HCM360 · Daily Dose #6
📋  PSB scoring, auto-ranked
Five criteria, twelve applicants, ranked in seconds. CSC-compliant by design.

The PSB Score Sheet computes the comparative ranking the moment the last interview score is entered. The Resolution PDF is auto-generated with the right CSC fields. Selection panels finish in one sitting.

Why it's cool
  • Five criteria with the CSC weights baked in: Education, Experience, Training, Performance, Interview.
  • Eligibility column is verified live against the CSC and PRC registries.
  • Top-ranked candidate is endorsed automatically; the next two are kept as alternates.
  • Resolution PDF is signed digitally — no pile of papers to chase.
How to use it
  1. Open Recruitment → PSB Deliberations for the requisition.
  2. Add PSB members for the session.
  3. Members enter scores as they interview. The ranking updates live.
  4. Click Generate PSB Resolution when scoring is complete.
Open PSB →

HCM360 · Daily Dose #7
🛡  CSC eligibility, never expired again
One matrix shows every position, every incumbent, every renewal date.

The Eligibility Compliance Matrix checks every plantilla position against on-file proof and shouts when something's missing or about to expire. PRC and CSC registries are queried nightly so you never get caught flat-footed in an audit.

Why it's cool
  • Live registry calls to CSC, PRC, and DICT. Verified results are stamped with the source and timestamp.
  • Four views: By Position, By Employee, By Eligibility, Gaps. Pivot whichever way you need.
  • Alerts at 90, 30, and 0 days before expiry — direct on the matrix and in ARIA's morning Alarm Scan.
  • Tracks the full eligibility taxonomy: Career Service Prof, Sub-Prof, RA 1080, RA 6850, DICT, Veterans, Honor Grad.
How to use it
  1. Open Recruitment → Eligibility Compliance.
  2. Switch to the Gaps tab to work the action queue.
  3. Click 🔍 Verify with CSC Registry on any applicant or incumbent record.
See compliance matrix →

HCM360 · Daily Dose #8
🚀  Onboarding that doesn't get lost in email
Six stages, every checklist item visible, the buddy gets a nudge automatically.

From the moment an appointment is signed, the new hire's onboarding is on rails. Every form, every signature, every welcome session has an owner and a date. The buddy gets pinged at Day 1, 7, 14, and 30. Nobody falls through.

Why it's cool
  • Six stages — REQUIREMENTS → WELCOME → TRANSITION → SIGNOFF → READY → ACTIVATED — with progress bar.
  • Auto-creates the IPCR scaffold the moment the hire hits ACTIVATED.
  • Buddy programme is built-in: scheduled tasks at Day 1 / 7 / 14 / 30.
  • Day 1 is delightful for the new hire because nothing is missing.
How to use it
  1. When an appointment is signed, the tracker is created automatically.
  2. Open Recruitment → Onboarding and pick the new hire.
  3. Tick checklist items as you complete them; click Advance to Next Stage when ready.
See onboarding →

HCM360 · Daily Dose #9
🏆  PRAISE & loyalty, never missed
The system spots service anniversaries before you do. Every nomination has a paper trail.

PRAISE is the recognition framework the LGU is required to run anyway. HCM360 just makes it effortless: nominate in two minutes, deliberate transparently, and let the system catch every loyalty milestone for you so nobody's 10-year goes by quietly.

Why it's cool
  • Loyalty Awards auto-detected at 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 years from continuous-service date.
  • Every CSC MC 28-2018 category supported, with scoring rubrics built in.
  • Resolution PDF and Certificate of Recognition templates auto-fill for the Mayor's signature.
  • Self-nomination is allowed only for Best Innovation — the framework knows the rules.
How to use it
  1. Open Awards → PRAISE Nominations.
  2. Click + New Nomination, pick the nominee, the category, write the justification.
  3. Submit. The PRAISE Committee picks it up from there.
Nominate someone →

HCM360 · Daily Dose #10
🚨  One question, your morning briefing
“Anything for me to be alarmed of?” — ARIA scans 7 modules and tells you in 30 seconds.

The most-loved trick in the system. Type a single question and ARIA returns a colour-coded scan: what's clean, what to watch, what's on fire. Daily ritual for HR Admins and the Mayor's office.

Why it's cool
  • One pass across attendance, leave, attrition risk, document compliance, workflow, and onboarding.
  • Returns three buckets: ✅ no issues, 🟡 watch items, 🔴 action needed.
  • Each item is a deep link — click and you're at the record.
  • Comes pre-loaded as the Full HR Summary quick action in ARIA's sidebar.
How to use it
  1. Open 🤖 ARIA Chat.
  2. Click Full HR Summary in the Quick Actions panel — or just type “anything for me to be alarmed of?”.
  3. Skim the ✅/🟡/🔴 buckets and follow the deep links.
Run my Alarm Scan →
